edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the sender identity used by the transfer entrypoint.
StartTrading relies on owner() == _msgSender() which derives from msg.sender.
lastLpBurnTime is initialized from block.timestamp in StartTrading.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens writes lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens gates execution on block.timestamp cooldown.
_transfer compares block.timestamp against lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency to trigger burns.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
tx.origin is the key written into _holderLastTransferTimestamp.
_transfer enforces the one-purchase-per-block rule using tx.origin.
swapBack is invoked from inside _transfer before balances settle, making external calls.
_transfer conditionally calls autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens on sell.
_transfer sets the swapping guard true before swapBack and false afterwards.
_transfer accumulates the liquidity fee share into tokensForLiquidity.
_transfer accumulates the marketing fee share into tokensForMarketing.
_transfer accumulates the dev fee share into tokensForDev.
_transfer writes the block number keyed by tx.origin in the delay mapping.
_transfer reads maxTransactionAmount to bound buy and sell amounts.
_transfer reads maxWallet and compares against amount + balanceOf(to).
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to decide fee taking and trading gate bypass.
_transfer branches on limitsInEffect to enforce whale protection.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens to ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH are available.
swapBack makes an external value call to devWallet which may execute arbitrary code.
swapBack forwards the remaining balance via an external call to marketingWallet.
swapBack reads devWallet to compute and send the dev ETH share.
swapBack reads marketingWallet as the recipient of the final ETH call.
swapBack resets tokensForLiquidity to zero after distribution.
swapBack resets tokensForMarketing to zero after distribution.
swapBack resets tokensForDev to zero after distribution.
swapTokensForEth forwards the token amount into the external router swap.
addLiquidity forwards tokenAmount and ethAmount into the external router call.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync() on the external pair contract.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync() on the external pair contract.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads percentForLPBurn to size the burn.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens updates lastLpBurnTime.
StartTrading sets tradingActive under onlyOwner.
StartTrading sets swapEnabled under onlyOwner.
StartTrading initializes lastLpBurnTime.
removeLimits permanently clears limitsInEffect under onlyOwner.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount under onlyOwner.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet under onlyOwner.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount under onlyOwner.
updateBuyFees writes buyTotalFees under onlyOwner with a 10% cap.
updateSellFees writes sellTotalFees under onlyOwner with a 10% cap.
excludeFromFees writes _isExcludedFromFees under onlyOwner.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair modifies pair classification state under onlyOwner.
updateMarketingWallet writes marketingWallet under onlyOwner.
updateDevWallet writes devWallet under onlyOwner.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnFrequency under onlyOwner.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes percentForLPBurn under onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership is gated by owner() == _msgSender().
External value calls in swapBack can re-enter token transfer logic while the swapping flag state is mid-flight.
